h1: Custom Multi Color Pencils for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Pencils | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color pencils for your brand. Perfect for events, tradeshows, and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom multi color pencils let you put your brand in a palette that catches attention. Unlike standard single-color pencils, these combine several hues in one barrel or set, making them ideal for school supply kits, art-themed events, or creative corporate gifts. Choose imprint methods like foil stamping or full-color printing to display your logo prominently. Whether you need a dozen for a small workshop or thousands for a back-to-school promotion, multi color pencils add a playful yet professional touch to any giveaway.
heroAltText: Bulk custom multi color pencils with printed logos arranged on a desk, showcasing various barrel colors.
